layers.label: Residents per km² of populated block area
layers.why: Cafés live on residents nearby; block density ignores parks and rail land.

layers.label: Share of residents aged 18–45
layers.why: Specialty coffee demand skews to young adults.

layers.label: Complementary POIs per km² (bakery, restaurant, fast food)
layers.why: Food POIs signal daytime footfall and agglomeration.

layers.label: Scheduled departures 07–10 + 16–19 (stations in or ≤ 400 m)
layers.why: Commuter flows in both peaks bring walk-in customers.

layers.label: Distance to the nearest StEP centre (type-weighted)
layers.why: Closer to a centre means more passers-by.

layers.label: OSM cafés per 10,000 residents
layers.why: Saturation, not raw café counts, measures competition.

crosschecks.label: OSM vs IHK café count
crosschecks.rule: not a score layer; if both counts ≥ 3 and max/min > 2 → confidence −1 and an unknown

crosscheck.text: OSM lists {osm} cafés, the IHK register {ihk}; the café count is uncertain.
crosscheck.suggested_validation: Count cafés on site or check a current map service.
